title: E-FND-0081: under the momentum-conserving knit on the committed mesh a lone tone is a classical ballistic particle...
purpose: Experiment E-FND-0081 in the foundations arena: under the momentum-conserving knit on the committed mesh a lone tone is a classical ballistic particle: the vacuum stays empty, the tone occupies exactly one slot and moves exactly one cell per beat in a straight line, two tones on parallel or crossing lines evolve as the exact union of their separate runs, and opposite-sign head-on tones pass through without annihilating, while the charge rule flashes and pins and the coined walk spreads.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
